note: min+gz budgets in bytes, enforced by scripts/size-check.mjs (esbuild bundle via the published exports map, minify, gzip -9). The full budget is the measured baseline + 2%. `baseline` blocks record the last measured numbers behind a budget — they are evidence, not gates. Entries with pending:true cover subpaths that are not exported yet; the gate skips them while the specifier does not resolve. Informational entries (no gzipBudgetBytes) are measured and printed, never gated.

fixtures.name: full
fixtures.note: Budget = the 8429 B pre-0.5.0 baseline + 2%, USER-signed. Phase 7 landed at 8583 B (+12 B vs the pre-Phase-7 cb1735a measurement of 8571 B: +27 B is the R2 mangler correctness fix, +67 B capability glue, -82 B recovered by translate golf). The budget is deliberately NOT re-anchored to 8583 — the 15 B of remaining headroom is the fixed envelope the plan reserved.

fixtures.name: slim
fixtures.note: Ratcheted 6912 -> 5760 after the Phase-7 capability decomposition (measured 5728 B + 32 B drift margin; -1049 B vs the 6777 B Phase-1 floor). The original 5632 target is UNMET and is not relaxed silently: it needed lever L4 (extension-driven translate assembly), which was implemented twice, measured at -105 B against its 250 B abort floor, and rejected — it also cost the full entry +168 B, which would have blown the signed 8598. The remaining 96 B would come from C3 (post-process pipeline hook + narrowed slim options, ~-80 B) plus a bounded golf pass; the USER declined C3 for 0.5.0 (API cost > 96 B benefit). Tracked in .omc/plans/open-questions.md.
